background: Aldermore is a UK specialist lender owned by South Africa's FirstRand, funded by online retail and business savings and lending on buy-to-let and owner-occupied mortgages, asset finance and invoice finance, with MotoNovo in motor finance.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the bank, at BBB+ on a negative outlook despite a one-notch upgrade on 16 Jan 2026, which makes the outlook the thing to watch. Capital is middling for UK mid-sized banks, CET1 of 13.6% below the peer median but leverage of 8.3% above it. Liquidity is the weaker side, with LCR of 170% below the median and NSFR of 129% in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Jun 2023 CET1 has fallen 1.2 points, leverage 0.6 points and LCR 41 points, a steady erosion across the board.
